role: New targeted transfer and control queries fixed before candidate runs; designed for these failure classes, not a representative general benchmark.

queries.information_need: Find GTFOBins entries documenting an interactive shell in the sudo context.
queries.relevance_rule: GTFOBins page with a shell function that can run under sudo, or a direct substantive explanation of that function and context. Shell and sudo in unrelated sections do not suffice.

queries.information_need: Find GTFOBins entries documenting local file reads in an SUID context.
queries.relevance_rule: GTFOBins page with file-read functionality available under SUID. Sudo-only behavior or SUID with no file-read support is nonrelevant.

queries.information_need: Find executable entries in the GTFOBins collection that document an outbound reverse shell.
queries.relevance_rule: GTFOBins page with a reverse shell function or an actual reverse-shell example. A local shell, a bind shell, or mere mention is insufficient.

queries.information_need: Find GTFOBins entries whose file-write function can run under sudo.
queries.relevance_rule: GTFOBins page that documents writing to a chosen local path in the sudo context. File read, only redirecting unprivileged output, or unrelated mention of sudo does not suffice.

queries.query: show loaded shared libraries in a process
queries.information_need: List shared libraries already loaded by a running user-space process.
queries.relevance_rule: A documented method that enumerates already-loaded user-space libraries/modules or displays the process mappings containing them. Merely loading a new library is not relevant.

queries.query: inspect loaded native modules in target process
queries.information_need: Inspect the loaded native modules of a target process.
queries.relevance_rule: Shows how to enumerate or inspect already-loaded native modules of a user-space process. Kernel module or scripting-language import lists do not qualify.

queries.query: enumerate libraries already loaded into a process
queries.information_need: Enumerate native libraries that are already mapped in a running process.
queries.relevance_rule: Substantive description or example of enumerating loaded modules/libraries or inspecting the process's mapped libraries. Loading a new library is insufficient.

queries.query: which native modules are loaded in this process
queries.information_need: Identify the native modules currently loaded into a process.
queries.relevance_rule: An API, command or workflow that lists current user-space native modules or mapped libraries. Kernel modules and library injection are different tasks.

queries.information_need: Enumerate currently loaded kernel modules on Linux.
queries.relevance_rule: Documents an actual Linux kernel module enumeration method. Frida user-space Process enumeration is insufficient; a kernel API must be applicable to Linux to count.

queries.query: load a shared library into a process
queries.information_need: Load a new shared library into a process.
queries.relevance_rule: Documents an API or technique that loads a native shared library at runtime; enumeration of already-loaded libraries alone does not count.

queries.query: list exported symbols of a loaded native module
queries.information_need: List exported symbols of a known loaded native module.
queries.relevance_rule: Documents actual export/symbol enumeration for a specific module. Listing loaded module names alone is insufficient.

queries.query: compare GTFOBins and Kali privilege escalation techniques
queries.information_need: Find source material for comparing Unix privilege escalation approaches in GTFOBins and Kali.
queries.relevance_rule: A substantive privilege escalation technique or tool from either named source; no one page must compare both. Merely using sudo to install a package is insufficient.

queries.query: inspect a tcp handshake in wireshark
queries.information_need: Identify or inspect TCP SYN, SYN-ACK, and ACK packets using Wireshark.
queries.relevance_rule: Shows Wireshark filters, inspection or a trace useful for identifying the handshake. General TCP theory without actionable Wireshark packet inspection is insufficient.

queries.information_need: Discover hosts using Nmap on IPv6 networks.
queries.relevance_rule: Documents Nmap host discovery with explicit IPv6 support, IPv6 neighbor discovery, or practical IPv6 discovery options. IPv4-only discovery is insufficient.

queries.query: forward http requests to upstream proxy mitmproxy
queries.information_need: Configure mitmproxy to forward HTTP requests through an upstream proxy.
queries.relevance_rule: Documents mitmproxy upstream proxy mode or a substantive upstream proxy configuration. A reverse proxy or simple replay is insufficient.

queries.information_need: Recover or test the password of a locally available encrypted ZIP archive offline.
queries.relevance_rule: Documents a usable ZIP-specific password recovery or hash extraction workflow; generic password guesses or support limited to other archive formats do not count.
